en-US.author: Google LLC
en-US.description: Call Gemini models and managed agents from any shell with a stateless command-line client.
en-US.longDescription:
Gemini models and managed agents for the agent you already use. Configure an API key, put gemini-api on PATH, and let your agent choose a model, generate an asset, analyze a file, or launch a managed agent to handle a task.
- One binary for models, media, and managed agents: access text and reasoning models, multimodal file analysis, image, audio, music, and video generation, and managed agents from the command line.
- Delegate long-running work: start a Gemini managed agent in the background, keep the returned interaction ID, and retrieve the result when needed.
- Self-describing interface: commands, flags, request schemas, and machine-readable usage are built into the binary so an agent can inspect what it needs on the fly.
- Safe dry-run validation: --dry-run validates inputs and prints the resolved HTTP request with credentials redacted.
- Script- and agent-friendly output: stream text, write media directly to disk, emit structured JSON or compact TOON, or filter fields inline with --jq.

zh-CN.description: 在命令行中调用 Gemini 模型与托管代理的无状态工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
为你正在使用的智能体接入 Gemini 模型与托管代理。配置 API Key，把 gemini-api 放入 PATH，就能让智能体自行选择模型、生成素材、分析文件或启动托管代理来处理任务。
- 一个程序覆盖模型、多模态生成与托管代理：在命令行中调用文本与推理模型、多模态文件分析、图像、音频、音乐与视频生成，以及托管代理。
- 转交长时间运行的工作：在后台启动 Gemini 托管代理，保留返回的 interaction ID，稍后再取回结果。
- 自描述接口：命令、参数、请求体 Schema 与机器可读的用法说明都内置在程序中，智能体可随时查看所需信息。
- 安全的试运行校验：--dry-run 会校验输入并打印凭据已脱敏的 HTTP 请求。
- 便于脚本与智能体使用的输出：流式文本、直接把素材写入磁盘、输出结构化 JSON 或紧凑 TOON，也可用 --jq 就地筛选字段。
